parts.label: a
parts.ask: Subscribers, in thousands, to company A are modelled by \(N_A = |t - 3| + 4\) and to company B by \(N_B = 8 - |2t - 6|\), \(t \geq 0\) years. Figure 2 sketches both graphs for 5 years: \(N_A\) is a V with its vertex at \(t = 3\), \(N_B\) an upside-down V peaking at \(t = 3\); they cross twice. Find the initial difference between the numbers of subscribers.
parts.answerText: The difference is 5 thousand, so \(5000\) subscribers.

parts.label: b
parts.ask: When \(t = T\), company A reduced its prices and its number of subscribers increased. Suggest a value for \(T\), giving a reason.

steps.text: \(N_A = |t - 3| + 4\) falls until \(t - 3 = 0\), then rises: its vertex is at \(t = 3\).

parts.answerText: \(T = 3\), because that is when company A had its lowest number of subscribers; after it, the number increased.

parts.label: c
parts.ask: Find the range of values of \(t\) for which \(N_A > N_B\), giving your answer in set notation.
parts.method: Find where the graphs cross, then read off from the sketch

steps.text: For \(0 \leq t < 3\), both moduli have negative insides, so they change sign:
In Figure 2, \(N_A\) is above \(N_B\) before the first crossing and after the second, so \(t < \tfrac{5}{3}\) or \(t > \tfrac{13}{3}\).
steps.why: Between the crossings \(N_B\) is higher: take the outside region.

check.assert: solveset(Abs(Symbol('t', real=True) - 3) + 4 > 8 - Abs(2*Symbol('t', real=True) - 6), Symbol('t', real=True), S.Reals) == Union(Interval.open(-oo, Rational(5, 3)), Interval.open(Rational(13, 3), oo))

parts.label: d
parts.ask: State a limitation of the model used for company B.
parts.method: Look at what happens to \(N_B\) for large \(t\)
parts.answerText: For \(t > 7\) the model gives a negative number of subscribers, which is impossible.

check.answers: a limitation of the model: no number to compare
